Document: - 1. Your character is an employee aboard a cutting-edge space station. Their first and last name must fit the setting and roleplay standards. Clowns and mimes are given more leeway to use humorous names than captains. - 2. Your character's name must suit their species. You are expected to read and have a basic understanding of your species' lore. You can click the "Randomize" button beside the character's name to get an idea of the names typical for each species. Abbreviated names (Morgan J.) and nicknames (Morgan "Graffiti" James) are not allowed. - 3. Take character creation seriously. The first or last names of celebrities, actors, and characters from films, television series, anime, games, and so on are prohibited, as are similar names. Absurd names (for example, Moon Luck) are likewise prohibited. The administration may therefore ask you to change your name, and measures may be taken if you refuse. - 4. When creating a character, choose a voice that matches their appearance. Do not give an organic character a robotic voice. Likewise, do not give an adult bearded man a high-pitched feminine voice. - 5. Copying the names of characters that you or someone else played before their death or cryogenic storage is prohibited. The punishment will be more severe if that character held a position of responsibility and remained on the crew manifest.
